hero.subtitle: Rural house in Granada ideal for families and groups, with pool, garden and natural surroundings just minutes from Granada city.

house.title: The house
house.intro: Vivienda Rural Huerta del Medio is a rural house in Granada with 4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and capacity for up to 10 guests. It features a spacious living room with air conditioning and a pellet stove, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private outdoor area with pool, barbecue and parking.
house.sectionBody: The house is arranged over two floors. On the first floor you’ll find the living room, equipped kitchen and a full bathroom. On the second floor there are 4 bedrooms: two with a double bed and terrace, and two with single beds. There is also a second full bathroom.
amenities: Comfortable and flexible check-in (subject to availability)

homeSeo.title: Rural house in Granada to relax and enjoy
homeSeo.intro: Vivienda Rural Huerta del Medio is a rural accommodation in Granada for those looking for peace, nature and a comfortable stay. Check availability online and book directly via WhatsApp or the form.
homeSeo.section1Title: Ideal rural accommodation for families and groups
homeSeo.section1Body: If you’re looking for a rural house in Granada for a weekend getaway, family holidays or a few days with friends, this place offers spacious areas and a perfect setting to rest.
homeSeo.section2Title: Comfort and outdoor space to enjoy every moment
homeSeo.section2Body: The house is ready for complete stays: equipped kitchen, relaxing areas, comfortable rooms and a private outdoor space with pool and barbecue.
homeSeo.section3Title: A great base to discover Granada and nearby areas
homeSeo.section3Body: A great base to visit Granada and return to calm at the end of the day, with nature and routes nearby.
bullets: Direct booking via WhatsApp or form
homeSeo.noteBody: If you already have approximate dates, check the calendar and message us—we usually reply quickly.

faq.a: In the Availability section you’ll see the updated calendar. If your dates are free, contact us via WhatsApp or the form to confirm.

faq.q: Is the house rented as a whole?
faq.a: Yes, Vivienda Rural Huerta del Medio is booked as an entire place so you can enjoy privacy and comfort.

faq.q: Is it suitable for families and groups?
faq.a: Yes. It’s ideal for families and groups looking for a rural house in Granada with space and a quiet setting.
You can request a booking via WhatsApp or the contact form. We’ll reply with confirmation and the necessary details.

faq.q: Where is the rural house located?
faq.a: The location is shown on the map in the Location section. It’s a convenient base to visit Granada and explore the natural surroundings.

faq.q: What information should I send when contacting you?
faq.a: Share approximate dates, number of guests and any questions. That helps us confirm availability and conditions.
